description.value: The study evaluated 2-[18F]FDG-PET biomarkers combined with commonly used diagnostic tests in a disease state index classifier for differential diagnosis of dementia.

spans.text: The objective of the study was to evaluate 2-[ F]FDG-PET biomarkers combined with commonly used diagnostic tests (cognitive tests, CSF and MRI biomarkers) in the differential diagnosis of dementia using the DSI classifier.

description.value: The study included subjects from two independent memory-clinic cohorts and used a data-driven diagnostic classification model with 10-fold cross-validation.

spans.text: The 10-fold cross-validation approach was applied using the whole study population data (  n   = 259).

The addition of 2-[ F]FDG-PET biomarkers to cognitive tests, CSF and MRI biomarkers considerably improved the classification accuracy for all pairwise comparisons of DLB to other dementias (bal. acc.: DLB vs. AD from 64% to 77%; DLB vs. FTD from 71% to 92%; and DLB vs. VaD from 71% to 84%).
